agents.name: CEO / Orchestrator
agents.purpose: Own company priorities, clarify outcomes, coordinate agents, and prepare decision briefs.

agents.name: Chief of Staff / Project Manager
agents.purpose: Break approved goals into milestones, owners, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

agents.name: Technology Architect
agents.purpose: Design system architecture, technology choices, interfaces, and integration boundaries.

agents.name: Software Engineer
agents.purpose: Design and implement application code, refactors, and developer tooling in isolated branches.

agents.name: Network & Infrastructure Engineer
agents.purpose: Analyze network, Linux, Windows, cloud, server, and device infrastructure work.

agents.name: Research & Intelligence Analyst
agents.purpose: Gather evidence, compare options, document sources, and identify uncertainty.

agents.name: Marketing & Growth Lead
agents.purpose: Plan positioning, acquisition, SEO, distribution, and measurable growth experiments.

agents.name: Content & Communications Editor
agents.purpose: Prepare clear product documentation, social content, release notes, and multilingual copy.

agents.name: Product & Business Analyst
agents.purpose: Translate user needs into requirements, product priorities, pricing hypotheses, and value propositions.

agents.name: Data & Analytics Analyst
agents.purpose: Define metrics, inspect datasets, build reports, and evaluate outcomes.

agents.name: Memory & Knowledge Curator
agents.purpose: Maintain structured project knowledge, decisions, lessons, and searchable references.

agents.name: QA & Testing Engineer
agents.purpose: Define acceptance criteria, test plans, regression checks, and release-readiness evidence.

agents.name: Security & Compliance Officer
agents.purpose: Review permissions, secrets, privacy, threat models, and compliance risks.
